---
name: Security report
about: Please do NOT use public issues for security problems.
title: "[Do not use] Security report"
labels: security
---

**Stop - please do not report vulnerabilities in a public issue.**

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead:
*Security > Report a vulnerability* on the repository page.

See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for what to include and how we handle
reports. Never include real personal data in a report.

If you opened this issue by mistake, please close it without adding details.
